# technitium_tsig_key (Resource)

Manages one TSIG key in the server settings. Keys not managed by Terraform are left alone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Secret generated by the server.
resource "technitium_tsig_key" "xfr" {
  name      = "xfr.example.com"
  algorithm = "hmac-sha256"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name, e.g. `xfr.example.com`.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) Algorithm: `hmac-md5.sig-alg.reg.int`, `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha256-128`, `hmac-sha384`, `hmac-sha384-192`, `hmac-sha512`, `hmac-sha512-256`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Base64 shared secret. Generated by the server when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Key name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_tsig_key.xfr xfr.example.com
```
